decision.summary: No new action: with only 6 hours left, all nearby daily and weekly BTC contracts are too weak to justify a fresh entry.
decision.rationale: The market is effectively flat intraday and still below the cleaner bullish extension trigger Beecthor had highlighted, while the board has already repriced away most remaining edge. The nearest daily reach, 79k on May 2, is only about 21%, and the next bullish or bearish strikes are even weaker. Weekly reach and dip contracts are also far too discounted to be meaningful here. With no open positions, neutral Binance structure, and low-probability contracts across the board, the disciplined choice is NO_ACTION.
